mapper.select: SELECT u.user_name AS username,u.nick_name AS name,r.role_key AS role,IF(u.status='0','Active','Disabled') AS status,DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id WHERE u.role_id IN (10,20,30) AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},u.user_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},u.nick_name)>0)AND r.role_key=#{role}AND u.status=#{status} ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 10001

SELECT c.title AS course,c.status AS status,COALESCE(u.user_name,'') AS mentor,COALESCE(u.nick_name,'') AS mentorName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_enrollment e JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=e.student_id AND s.status='0' AND s.role_id=10 WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.active=1) AS students,c.difficulty AS difficulty,c.estimated_minutes AS minutes FROM learning_course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.mentor_id WHERE c.deleted=0 AND LOCATE(#{keyword},c.title)>0AND c.status=#{status} ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 10001

SELECT s.user_name AS username,s.nick_name AS name,c.title AS course,COALESCE(m.user_name,'') AS mentor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_chapter ch WHERE ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED') AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_chapter ch JOIN learning_chapter_progress p ON p.chapter_id=ch.id WHERE p.student_id=s.id AND p.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED') AS completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a WHERE a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED') AS assignments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id=a.id WHERE sub.student_id=s.id AND sub.status='SUBMITTED' AND a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED') AS waiting, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id=a.id WHERE sub.student_id=s.id AND sub.status='GRADED' AND a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED') AS graded, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment a JOIN assignment_submission sub ON sub.assignment_id=a.id WHERE sub.student_id=s.id AND sub.status='RETURNED' AND a.course_id=c.id AND a.status='PUBLISHED') AS returned FROM learning_course c JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.active=1 JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=e.student_id AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=c.mentor_id WHERE c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.id=#{courseId}AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},s.user_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},s.nick_name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},c.title)>0) ORDER BY c.id,s.id LIMIT 10001
